scope.finite_stopping_rule: stop after current-state inventory and non-duplicate dependency synthesis

normalization_and_dependency_rule: Canonical registries are authoritative; DB runtime is treated as an operational projection. Runtime debt, canonical debt, induction, validation, and promotion are distinct states. Recommendations are ordered by direct unlock value and are non-executable.

discoveries.title: Runtime projection is fresher/incomplete relative to canonical obligation state
discoveries.statement: The runtime reports no open debt while canonical D and lexicon surfaces retain open obligations, and the DB snapshot is stale.
discoveries.falsification_condition: A fresh DB snapshot and current-state query agree with canonical open-obligation counts.

discoveries.title: D/E remain the live D-semantics frontier
discoveries.statement: OBL-D-001D and OBL-D-001E remain OPEN after A-C bounded discharge states.
discoveries.falsification_condition: An authorized gate report records accepted evidence and a non-open status for both obligations.

discoveries.title: Lexicon induction has not become validation
discoveries.statement: Eleven queue entries remain GAP_OPEN; provisional and resolved counts do not validate those terms.
discoveries.falsification_condition: All eleven exact entries acquire governed validation records and the runtime check passes.

discoveries.title: Bounded D/E formalization and lexicon review
discoveries.statement: A successor package should define measurable D/E acceptance tests and separately review the eleven GAP_OPEN terms.
discoveries.falsification_condition: Human review determines that no additional formalization or lexicon evidence is needed.

recommended_next_action.action: Prepare an authorized D/E obligation package with acceptance tests, then refresh the DB and validate; review lexicon gaps separately.
recommended_next_action.unlock: Aligns runtime projection, canonical obligation state, and evidence gates without conflating induction with promotion.

termination_reason: Current-state scope covered; further progress requires authorized formal evidence or DB refresh.
